name: picturereader
description: Turn local images into deterministic text evidence for text-only models: coarse luminance and color grids, structure fingerprints, exact pixel samples, dominant palettes, and reproducible region crops.
scope: Analyzes local PNG/JPEG/WebP/BMP/GIF images without external calls. It does not perform OCR, semantic image Q&A, document conversion, model-adapter interception, or external VLM routing.
